additional_primary_web_sources.basis: Read through web tool from issuer-linked CDN. Direct byte retrieval was rejected because this CDN is outside the shell network allowlist. No raw-byte hash or database ingestion is claimed.
additional_primary_web_sources.cross_checks: Exact RIL holding and award count match retained original. Exact share count times INR10 rounds to retained AOC-1 capital INR8,939.03 crore. Only ordinary equity is issued; preference share capital in note9 is authorised.

additional_primary_web_sources.use: Date-boundary evidence only. Do not remove March31 put because of an October event.

net_external_revenue_weights.exact_missing_disclosure: Segment revenue from external customers explicitly net of GST, or segment-level GST attributable to external versus intersegment turnover and the related consolidation elimination. The arithmetic sum reconciles but does not establish tax allocation.
net_external_revenue_weights.usable_now: Retain Diversified taxonomy. Gross-external percentages can be calculated as a separate gross-turnover analysis, but cannot be presented as the missing net-external revenue mix or installed as if comparable to net-revenue margin priors.

shares.rounding: Treasury and award counts reported in thousands; result is an estimate, not exact shares.
shares.method: Would treat remaining partly-paid shares as fully paid and all parent awards as converted, credit no additional call/exercise proceeds, and remove treasury shares before adding all awards. Does not cover subsidiaries.

subsidiary_awards.count_precision: Rounded to thousand shares; underlying companies differ.
subsidiary_awards.closed_now: Population and plan boundaries identified; do not add these numbers to Bharti parent shares.
subsidiary_awards.required_for_carrying_conversion_proxy: Matched-date subsidiary issued shares, treasury treatment, performance award share-conversion limits and parent economic ownership; corresponding consolidated ordinary-equity/earnings scope. A fair-value approach alternatively needs subsidiary equity/option valuation assumptions and matched terms.

nci_put.closed_now: The put is a redemption obligation over TPG/Mastercard AMC shares; their corresponding minority equity remains recognised until exercise. All AMC NCI is not the same claim population as put holders.
nci_put.not_valid: Subtracting both full INR469068m NCI and INR48729m redemption liability without removing the put-covered equity counts underlying shares twice. Replacing all AMC NCI with the put also drops non-put minority claims.
nci_put.exact_missing_disclosure: March31 carrying amount/ownership attributable specifically to TPG and Mastercard within AMC and Bharti consolidated NCI, including lower-tier/FX and consolidation adjustments. With that mapping, replace the covered equity amount with a consistently selected redemption claim. October extinguishment is a separate later event.
nci_put.additional_source_scope_conflict: Bharti note38 uses a48-month description, whereas Airtel Africa note35 describes the extension to60months and separately reports USD515m carrying/517m fair value. Do not infer an exact INR fair-value replacement by translating either rounded USD number.

perpetual_bonds.closed_now: Network i2i USD1000m perpetual bonds classified as NCI were redeemed in FY2025. Do not carry that historical issue forward as an extra FY2026 claim merely from generic share-rights wording.

parent_share_scope.remaining: Bank common-book basis presently excludes INR4,545.11crore separate employee-award reserve. A full-conversion equity basis must reconcile that reserve and all subsidiary award claims before promotion.
Life and General Insurance awards are separate claims on subsidiary shares. Cancelled Securities awards were replaced by parent awards and must not be added again.

Equal reported basic/diluted EPS averages establish no EPS dilution for the period, not proof of zero outstanding or anti-dilutive instruments. Ending issued shares are factual. Group ESOP exercise notes do not provide complete outstanding awards.

hdfc_subsidiary_awards.closure: Original parent receipt highlighted Securities only. Full retained group notes additionally disclose HDB, ERGO, Capital, Life and AMC. Parent all-award denominator does not extinguish these subsidiary claims.
hdfc_subsidiary_awards.exact_remaining: Reconcile date-matched subsidiary ordinary share capital/face values, treasury or employee-trust shares, maximum performance share conversion, ownership and parent common-equity/earnings carrying allocation. AOC1 page552 supplies rounded capital/reserves/ownership but has differing subsidiary accounting scopes; it is not by itself the full diluted consolidated bridge.

icici_subsidiary_awards.zero_basis: Securities tables explicitly show no outstanding options/units; they were cancelled and replaced by ICICI Bank awards in FY2025. This zero does not apply to Life/General claims.
icici_subsidiary_awards.exact_remaining: Life and General ordinary shares/treasury and consistent parent-attributable carrying equity/earnings after all-award conversion. Do not combine different subsidiary GAAP AOC1 values with bank consolidation values without reconciliation.

sbi_subsidiary_scope.closed_now: These are exercises during the period, already included in ending ownership and accounting equity. They are not outstanding unexercised grants and must not be added again.
sbi_subsidiary_scope.exact_remaining: FY2026 share-based-payment and capital notes of Cards, Life, Funds Management and General, plus relevant associate dilution where the carrying/earnings basis is used. Need year-end unexercised/conditional awards and their underlying equity scope, not exercise totals.

model_requirements.formula: Parent book equity + PV excess equity returns; divide by diluted_shares.
model_requirements.critical_behavior: Bank engine does not deduct employee_options_value, debt, leases or NCI. A nonzero awards field alone has no effect. Subsidiary dilution must be reflected consistently in pro forma parent equity and income, or a separately reviewed engine claim deduction must be implemented. Parent option-share dilution cannot represent subsidiary awards.
model_requirements.not_required: No invented operating-company revenue, FCFF margin or WACC components are needed for the bank engine.
